The '''Nuro pirates''' were a pirate gang on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] lead by [[Yorn Nuro]]. They supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Third battle of Felucia]] and stole a [[Nysillin farm (Nuro Pirates)|Nysillin farm]]. They started supplying the Confederacy with the [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]]. During the battle, the famed [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to defeat Yorn Nuro, which was successfully carried out. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carg]] of [[Graul Company]] also ordered the Jedi Knight to eliminate some of the Nuro Pirates around the farm.
